description: Implementation of an Epoll wrapper class for managing epoll file descriptors, including creation, adding, modifying, deleting, and waiting for events, with thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: Epoll
classes.description: A class encapsulating epoll file descriptor management with thread-safe operations for adding, modifying, deleting, and waiting for events.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new Epoll instance with epoll_create1 and returns a Result wrapping the Epoll object.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to the epoll set with specified events.

methods.name: AddOrModify
methods.description: Adds or modifies a file descriptor in the epoll set with specified events.

methods.name: Modify
methods.description: Modifies the event mask for a monitored file descriptor.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor from the epoll set.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for an event on the epoll set and returns the event details.
